table.name: TLGNR_COND_LOGON_TYPE_BS
table.description: Condition types coming from SAP, as distinguished by Logon as different types. All Pricing condition type/tables from SAP (tlgnr_cond_sap_type_bs/tx, e.g. 'ZTE3/A526') are mapped into a condition type as distinguished by Logon (e.g. 'TRv'). MP are the Material Price type, and those conditions are stored in tlgns_sap_mat_cond. TRv, TRf and TC are Transport Condition types and those conditions are stored in tlgns_sap_transport_cond.

column.name: COND_LOGON_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK. 'MP' for Material Price Conditions, 'TC', 'TRv' and 'TRf' for Transport Costs, Transport Rate variable, Transport Rate fixed. The Condition's Logon Type controls if a condition which is imported from SAP will be stored in tlgns_sap_mat_cond or tlgns_sap_transport_cond.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
